Anita (sales): Heads-up team — we’re pushing a new pricing matrix split for commits and burst tiers tomorrow morning. Link to the draft: https://inbox.redwood.internal/ratecards/pricing-matrix-2026
Anita (sales): Key change: separated per-token base for hosted API vs. dedicated commit credits; new commit SKU bands (S/M/L) and a propagation window (30 days) for existing deals :calendar:
ratebot: Automated notice: ratecard update published — id=rc_2026_03_split_v1 — docs: /ratecards/rc_2026_03_split_v1 (read-only until approvals complete)
Josiah (deal-desk): Quick Q: for active commits signed under rc_2025_v3, do we auto-map to the closest SKU or keep legacy pricing until renewal?
Anita (sales): @Josiah default plan is to grandfather existing deals at legacy pricing until renewal unless the customer opts into the new SKU mapping. We need Deal Desk to sign off on exceptions.
Josiah (deal-desk): Ok — I’ll pull the list of deals signed in last 12 months and flag >$100k for manual review. ETA EOD today.
Leah (finance): Need confirmation on max discount caps for the new SKUs. The spreadsheet currently says 20% standard, 30% with AM approval. Any special handling for mapping discounts from legacy commits?
Sarah (revops): We should preserve the effective discount percentage when mapping to new SKUs for the propagation window. After propagation window, normal discount caps apply. I’ll update quoting playbook.
Devon (security): Not pricing, but heads-up: a handful of enterprise customers have contract clauses referencing specific ratecard IDs. Legal needs a runbook for cross-references when we change IDs.
Anita (sales): Good catch @Devon — add Legal to the loop. We’ll include a mapping table in the final doc.
Josiah (deal-desk): For transparency, can we include the mapping snippet in the quoting UI? Something like:
```
{"legacy_id":"rc_2025_v3","new_id":"rc_2026_03_split_v1","map_policy":"preserve_discount_until_renewal"}
```
Leah (finance): That helps. Also, confirm revenue recognition: do commits that choose to opt into the new SKUs get reclassed? We’ll follow-up with Accounting if needed.
Sarah (revops): Process: 1) Publish draft (done) 2) Deal Desk QA & sample mapping (Josiah) 3) Legal review for contract-cross refs (Devon -> Legal) 4) Finance sign-off on discount caps & rev rec (Leah) 5) Final publish + console flag flip. Target publish: 2026-04-01 07:00 UTC :rocket:
ratebot: Reminder scheduled: review-deadline (rc_2026_03_split_v1) in 48 hours
Anita (sales): Can everyone with approvals please add their final +1 or block by Friday 16:00 PT? If no blocks, we’ll proceed with the phased rollout and grandfathering rules above. :thumbsup:
Josiah (deal-desk): +1 assuming deal exceptions list will be reviewed before rollout
Leah (finance): +1 (pending Accounting confirmation on rev rec note)
Devon (security): +1 — Legal will post required contract addendum language once they finish review
Sarah (revops): +1 — I’ll push the quoting playbook update and the UI mapping snippet
Anita (sales): Thanks all — will follow up with final doc and rollout checklist. :eyes:
